svg.title: DIA-004A · The brake, drawn to scale
svg.desc: An engraved plate. One long hatched bar spans the page: near $856 billion, OpenAI’s projected compute spending through 2030. Three oversight figures are drawn on the same scale beneath it and are too thin to see: the UK AI Security Institute's yearly budget, the largest AI fine imposed to date, and the yearly budget of the US institute. A magnifying glass at 100 diameters shows the UK institute as a sliver. A second glass at 10,000 diameters shows the fine and the US budget as short bars.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 4 · WHO WAS SUPPOSED TO SLOW IT
UK AI Security Institute, $84M a year
The largest AI fine to date, €15M (Italy, December 2024)
(all three are drawn. None is wide enough to hold ink.)
DIA-004A · One scale throughout. Two oversight budgets and the largest fine to date are thinner than the ink until magnified.
